libbrillo: Use a unique_ptr for EVP_MD_CTX In OpenSSL 1.1, the EVP_MD_CTX struct will become opaque, and therefore it will not be possible to allocate on the stack. Replace this stack allocation with a heap allocated EVP_MD_CTX using the existing OpenSSL 1.0.2 create/destroy APIs, and manage its lifetime using a unique_ptr<>.
